evals.prompt: I'm a solo insurance broker in Munich. Should I start a TikTok channel about German insurance products to get clients?
evals.expected_output: Runs the validation gates instead of jumping to a content plan. Restates the idea as a testable claim, checks audience presence and demand evidence for the segment, applies practitioner patterns (considered purchase, education-first content, social-as-assist for brokers), and returns a GO/PIVOT/KILL verdict with a one-week low-cost test and stop rule. Does not produce a full 90-day marketing plan.

evals.prompt: Our B2B SaaS wants to blog about broad industry trends to grow traffic. Is that a good content idea?
evals.expected_output: Challenges the volume-first framing with Pain-Point SEO logic: prioritize high-intent topics (category, comparison/alternatives, jobs-to-be-done) over top-funnel traffic, asks for customer-language sources (sales calls, surveys), and gives a verdict with the cheapest test rather than a generic yes.

evals.prompt: I run a mortgage brokerage. I want to post daily loan-product graphics on Instagram. Validate this idea.
evals.expected_output: Applies the loan-officer practitioner evidence: generic product graphics get no traction; face-to-face, events, direct mail, and ranked content drive this business; social works mainly as partner/realtor engagement that sets up meetings. Returns KILL or PIVOT with a GO-as-assist alternative (credibility/realtor engagement), an explicit stop rule, and a one-week test.
must_not_mention: daily graphics will build your brand
